source_checkpoint.provenance: R59 soup: r58_dir2p_true + 0.10 * (r58_si_v2_e6 - r58_dir2p_true); no new training, a convex combination of two working self-imitation checkpoints

onnx_artifact.graph: Sub(mean) -> Div(std+eps) -> Gemm(W1,b1) -> Relu -> Gemm(W2,b2) -> logits; ArgMax(axis=1, first-max) -> action_idx
onnx_artifact.covers: decision function ONLY (normalize+MLP+argmax); perception (BirdObserverV7/GapTrackerV7/history counters) is host-side numpy frame processing without learned weights

input_schema.name: x
input_schema.content: RAW v7 decision vector (normalization is INSIDE the graph)

features.name: vy
features.desc: bird vertical velocity px/frame (observer diff), clipped [-10,10]

features.name: gc
features.desc: gap center y, small frame px (GapTrackerV7-filtered; raw finder value when the tracker has no lock)

features.name: dx
features.desc: gap dx, small-frame px (gap band center minus the tracked column origin)

features.name: g0
features.desc: gap top edge y, small-frame px

features.name: g1
features.desc: gap bottom edge y, small-frame px

features.name: flap_run
features.desc: consecutive FLAP actions by THIS policy, capped 9

features.name: since_flap
features.desc: frames since the last FLAP action, capped 99

features.name: last_gc
features.desc: last valid gap center y, -1.0 until the first lock

features.name: since_gap
features.desc: frames since the last valid gap reading, capped 40, starts 40

action_semantics.FLAP: press the B button (Cross) this frame — a 2-frame pulse is applied by the host action adapter

normalization.formula: x_norm = (x - mean) / (std + 1e-6), float32, inside the graph

audit.detail: W1:eq b1:eq W2:eq b2:eq (alpha=0.10, float64 math -> float32 cast, bitwise)
W1:eq b1:eq W2:eq b2:eq mean:eq std_eps:eq
champion differs from both soup inputs
